1) CHARACTER: Orange/copper hair in messy double buns with loose strands and hairpins; brown eyes; fair skin; freckle-like marks on cheeks; open smiling mouth; slender athletic build; braided bracelet on left wrist.
2) CLOTHING STATE: Light blue/white colorblock tank top (chest and stomach covered), orange-green plaid pleated skirt (hips/thighs covered), knee-high white sock with teal stripe on one leg, strappy brown sandals. Chest fully covered, no visible shape/nipple detail under fabric; skirt flares with pose but no clear upskirt exposure; arms and shoulders bare.
3) POSE: Dynamic descending/crouching motion on stairs; left arm extended back and up (hand open), right arm reaching forward/down; one leg bent high on a step, other leg extended lower; energetic, mid-movement.
4) CAMERA: Upper-body-to-cowboy framing (head to mid-calf), high diagonal angle, tilted/dutch composition following staircase line, character viewed from above.
5) SCENE: Indoor staircase with wooden handrail and vertical balusters; props: calico cat walking down stairs below; strong warm golden/orange backlighting with halftone dot texture, sun-drenched high-contrast glow.
6) RATING VERDICT: PG-13 — fully covered chest and hips, dynamic action pose, no erotic emphasis.
7) ACID/LSD THEME: No — warm golden palette with halftone print texture only; no kaleidoscopes, prisms, rainbow oil slicks, or melting/hallucinatory patterns.
